structuremover.configuration.title: Structure Mover Config
structuremover.configuration.maxBlocks.t: Maximum number of blocks a single selection may contain.
structuremover.configuration.diagonalCon: Count blocks touching only by an edge or corner as connected.
structuremover.configuration.ignoreTerra: Do not follow natural blocks like dirt, stone, sand, plants and liquids, so the scan never swallows the ground.
structuremover.configuration.moveTreeLea: Move the leaves that belong to a selected tree too.
structuremover.configuration.replaceTerr: Replace natural terrain at the destination instead of being blocked by it. Undo restores it.
structuremover.configuration.ignoredBloc: Extra blocks the scan must not follow. Block ids or #tags.
structuremover.configuration.alwaysInclu: Blocks that are never treated as terrain. Block ids or #tags.
structuremover.configuration.overwriteEx: Allow the moved building to replace any existing block at the destination.
structuremover.configuration.requireCrea: Only players in creative mode can use the wand.
structuremover.configuration.showBlockPr: Show a transparent preview of the selected blocks where they will be placed.
structuremover.configuration.previewOpac: How see-through the placement preview is (1.0 = solid).
structuremover.configuration.previewMaxB: Most blocks drawn in the placement preview. Bigger buildings are thinned out evenly.
